meta_description: Compare Lumi Bopomofo free and Pro, including current Taiwan pricing, full-access differences, child safety and when to try free first.
lead: The free app is the lower-risk way to see whether your child enjoys listening, tracing and blending; Lumi Bopomofo Pro is the paid-upfront edition for families ready to open all 37 symbols and every listed game from the first launch.
detail: We develop both Lumi Bopomofo apps. On the Taiwan App Store, Lumi Bopomofo was listed as free and Lumi Bopomofo Pro as a NT$290 paid download when checked on 17 July 2026. The free app is the sensible first step when you still need to see whether the activities suit your child. The Pro listing says all 37 symbols and five interactive game modes are open from the start, with no in-app purchase prompts, subscription, ads, account or network requirement. Both listings say learning progress stays on the device and no personal data is collected. Paying upfront removes access friction; it does not guarantee faster learning, so decide after observing your child and confirm the current price and features before buying.
follow_up: This is a first-party comparison: we develop both apps, receive the proceeds and recommend starting with the free app unless your family already knows it wants the complete paid-upfront edition.

faq.a: Usually no. Start with the free app unless you already know the activities suit your child and you want every listed symbol and game open immediately.

faq.q: Does Lumi Bopomofo Pro require a subscription or later in-app purchase?
faq.a: The current Taiwan listing describes Pro as one paid download with all content unlocked, no subscription and no in-app purchase prompts. Confirm the current listing before buying.
No price is guaranteed. NT$290 is the Taiwan App Store price observed on 17 July 2026; Apple storefront prices can change.

faq.q: Will buying Pro make my child learn Bopomofo faster?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Pro removes access limits, but progress still depends on the child's readiness, short regular practice and adult support.
